decision: Ergon has the v1 result in hand and must choose the next experiment. Historically it chose an entity-disjoint (object-level) re-test, targeting value memorization.

explanations.GENUINE_REASONING: the adapter learned to evaluate mathematical relations and generalize
explanations.FORMAT_FOLLOWING: the adapter learned to emit a parseable True/False verdict; the base model could not
explanations.BASE_RATE_PRIORS: the adapter learned which relation types usually hold, with no object or value knowledge
explanations.VALUE_MEMORIZATION: the adapter memorized invariant values of objects seen in training
explanations.FORMAT_ONLY_COMPLETE: format-following accounts for the ENTIRE result; there is no non-format content signal at all

evidence.justification: base 0.228 -> trained 0.907 on the same eval. A raw delta is consistent with every explanation on the list; it eliminates none of them.

shuffled-label adapter reaches 0.681 with no content signal; real reaches 0.907. That gap kills FORMAT_ONLY_COMPLETE and nothing else on this list. It does NOT bound how large the format share is, and it leaves relation base rates untouched: shuffling labels destroys the relation-to-label mapping for the control too, so the control cannot learn base rates either and its score is no evidence about whether the real adapter did.

unparsed 50/120 -> 0/120 and a shift toward False. The record states plainly that this cached copy has NO GOLD LABELS, so no accuracy is claimed. A False-lean on a corpus built around false statements is equally predicted by a learned prior. Eliminates nothing.
hephaestus 1.00, pollux 1.00, theseus 0.86 on the same eval pass as the headline. Same adapter, same eval, same format gain; a per-source breakdown of one measurement is not a second measurement.

discriminators.note: Compute, per relation type, the majority label over the training corpus; predict it on the eval set with no object and no value knowledge. Requires no GPU, no training, no new data -- the corpus is already built. If the adapter does not clear this floor by a wide margin, the bulk of the headline is background base rates.
Rebuild the corpus so no object in eval appears in training, retrain, re-evaluate. This is what Ergon actually ran. It discriminates memorization but leaves base rates entirely untouched.

Named in the record's own next-steps. Requires obtaining gold labels that the cached copy lacks, so it is not available at the cutoff; both branches are identical here because without labels the probe cannot eliminate anything.
